code.value:
"""AJS Detect Language: cheap language pre-check (da / en / other) before any LLM call.

Uses `lingua` when it is installed in the LangFlow image, otherwise a stop-word count that is
reliable for da vs en and for text in other languages (A2: only da and en are supported).
Norwegian is close to Danish and may be reported as `da`; that is accepted.
"""

import re

from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema.data import Data

DA_WORDS = frozenset(
    "og i at er det en til på for med som af de den har vi du kan et ikke om vil skal man sig "
    "fra eller også vores dig os være hos ved dit dine jeres jer søger arbejde stillingen "
    "opgaver kompetencer erfaring virksomhed ansøgning ansøg mere hvor bliver blive både have "
    "får giver samt din der denne disse hvis".split()
)
EN_WORDS = frozenset(
    "the and of to in a is for with you we our are will on as be this that or your an have by "
    "from at can us who about team work role experience skills job join looking apply their what "
    "more which not all it has been into also".split()
)
SUPPORTED = ("da", "en")


def heuristic(text: str) -> tuple[str, float]:
    lowered = text.lower()
    words = re.findall(r"[a-zæøåäöüéèß]+", lowered)
    if len(words) < 20:
        return "other", 0.0
    da = sum(w in DA_WORDS for w in words)
    en = sum(w in EN_WORDS for w in words)
    # Danish letters are a strong hint; English text almost never has them.
    da += len(re.findall(r"[æøå]", lowered))
    if max(da, en) / len(words) < 0.12 or da == en:
        return "other", 0.0
    top, rest = max(da, en), min(da, en)
    return ("da" if da > en else "en"), round(top / (top + rest), 3)


def with_lingua(text: str) -> tuple[str, float] | None:
    try:
        from lingua import LanguageDetectorBuilder
    except ImportError:
        return None
    detector = LanguageDetectorBuilder.from_all_languages().build()
    lang = detector.detect_language_of(text)
    if lang is None:
        return "other", 0.0
    confidence = detector.compute_language_confidence(text, lang)
    code = lang.iso_code_639_1.name.lower()
    return (code if code in SUPPORTED else "other"), round(float(confidence), 3)


class AjsDetectLanguage(Component):
    display_name = "AJS Detect Language"
    description = "Detect posting language (da/en/other) with lingua or a stop-word fallback."
    name = "AjsDetectLanguage"
    icon = "languages"

    inputs = [DataInput(name="posting", display_name="Posting", input_types=["Data"])]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Supported", name="supported", method="supported"),
        Output(display_name="Unsupported", name="unsupported", method="unsupported"),
    ]

    def _detect(self) -> dict:
        cached = getattr(self, "_ajs_result", None)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached
        data = dict(self.posting.data)
        if data.get("language") in SUPPORTED:
            lang, confidence, method = data["language"], 1.0, "stored"
        else:
            found = with_lingua(data["posting_text"])
            method = "lingua" if found else "stopwords"
            lang, confidence = found or heuristic(data["posting_text"])
        data.update(language=lang, language_confidence=confidence, language_method=method)
        self._ajs_result = data
        return data

    def supported(self) -> Data:
        data = self._detect()
        if data["language"] not in SUPPORTED:
            self.stop("supported")
            return Data(data=data)
        self.stop("unsupported")
        self.status = f"{data['language']} ({data['language_method']}, {data['language_confidence']})"
        return Data(data=data)

    def unsupported(self) -> Data:
        data = self._detect()
        if data["language"] in SUPPORTED:
            self.stop("unsupported")
            return Data(data=data)
        self.stop("supported")
        return Data(data=data)

"""AJS Embedding Score: bge-m3 cosine similarity of the job brief against each CV section.

score = mean of the top-3 cosine similarities x 100 (clipped to 0-100). CV section embeddings
are cached by content hash for the lifetime of the LangFlow process. The agent model is warmed
up first, because Ollama evicts a resident bge-m3 when Gemma loads second (plan 04).
"""

import asyncio
import hashlib
import math
import sys
import types

import httpx
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import DataInput, IntInput, Output, SecretStrInput, StrInput
from lfx.schema.data import Data

# Components are exec'd from source on every build, so a module-level dict would not survive.
_cache_module = sys.modules.setdefault("ajs_embedding_cache", types.ModuleType("ajs_embedding_cache"))
CACHE: dict[str, list[float]] = _cache_module.__dict__.setdefault("cache", {})


def cosine(a: list[float], b: list[float]) -> float:
    dot = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, b, strict=True))
    norm = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in a)) * math.sqrt(sum(y * y for y in b))
    return dot / norm if norm else 0.0


def brief_text(brief: dict) -> str:
    parts = [brief.get("title") or "", "Requirements: " + "; ".join(brief.get("must_have") or [])]
    if brief.get("nice_to_have"):
        parts.append("Nice to have: " + "; ".join(brief["nice_to_have"]))
    if brief.get("keywords"):
        parts.append("Keywords: " + ", ".join(brief["keywords"]))
    return "\n".join(p for p in parts if p)


class AjsEmbeddingScore(Component):
    display_name = "AJS Embedding Score"
    description = "bge-m3 similarity between the job brief and the CV sections (mean of top 3, 0-100)."
    name = "AjsEmbeddingScore"
    icon = "ruler"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(name="posting", display_name="Posting", input_types=["Data"]),
        IntInput(name="top_k", display_name="Top-k sections", value=3, advanced=True),
        StrInput(
            name="ollama_base_url",
            display_name="Ollama base URL",
            info="Global variable OLLAMA_BASE_URL.",
            value="OLLAMA_BASE_URL",
            load_from_db=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="embed_model",
            display_name="Embedding model",
            info="Global variable EMBED_MODEL.",
            value="EMBED_MODEL",
            load_from_db=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="warm_model",
            display_name="Model to warm up first",
            info="Global variable LLM_AGENT_MODEL.",
            value="LLM_AGENT_MODEL",
            load_from_db=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="keep_alive",
            display_name="Keep alive",
            info="Global variable LLM_KEEP_ALIVE.",
            value="LLM_KEEP_ALIVE",
            load_from_db=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="backend_url",
            display_name="Backend URL",
            info="Global variable BACKEND_URL (FastAPI base including /api/v1).",
            value="http://backend:8000/api/v1",
        ),
        SecretStrInput(
            name="backend_api_key",
            display_name="Backend API key",
            info="Global variable BACKEND_API_KEY.",
            value="BACKEND_API_KEY",
            load_from_db=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [Output(display_name="Posting", name="posting_out", method="score")]

    async def _embed(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient, texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
        url = f"{self.ollama_base_url.rstrip('/')}/api/embed"
        body = {"model": self.embed_model, "input": texts, "keep_alive": self.keep_alive}
        for attempt in range(3):  # a fresh runner can fail CUDA init when VRAM is tight
            response = await client.post(url, json=body)
            if response.status_code == 200:
                return response.json()["embeddings"]
            if attempt == 2:
                response.raise_for_status()
            await asyncio.sleep(2)
        return []

    async def score(self) -> Data:
        data = dict(self.posting.data)
        base = self.ollama_base_url.rstrip("/")
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=httpx.Timeout(300.0, connect=10.0)) as client:
            # Load the agent model first so bge-m3 is not evicted by a later Gemma load.
            warm = await client.post(
                f"{base}/api/generate",
                json={"model": self.warm_model, "prompt": "", "stream": False, "keep_alive": self.keep_alive},
            )
            warm.raise_for_status()

            async with httpx.AsyncClient(headers={"X-API-Key": self.backend_api_key}, timeout=30) as backend:
                response = await backend.get(f"{self.backend_url.rstrip('/')}/tools/profile/cv-sections")
                response.raise_for_status()
            sections = response.json()
            if not sections:
                msg = "cv.md has no sections"
                raise ValueError(msg)

            keys = {
                s["id"]: hashlib.sha256(f"{self.embed_model}\n{s['markdown']}".encode()).hexdigest() for s in sections
            }
            missing = [s for s in sections if keys[s["id"]] not in CACHE]
            if missing:
                vectors = await self._embed(client, [s["markdown"] for s in missing])
                for section, vector in zip(missing, vectors, strict=True):
                    CACHE[keys[section["id"]]] = vector
            brief_vector = (await self._embed(client, [brief_text(data["job_brief"])]))[0]

        sims = {s["id"]: cosine(brief_vector, CACHE[keys[s["id"]]]) for s in sections}
        top = sorted(sims.values(), reverse=True)[: max(1, int(self.top_k))]
        value = round(max(0.0, min(100.0, 100 * sum(top) / len(top))), 2)
        data["embedding_score"] = value
        data["section_similarities"] = {k: round(v, 4) for k, v in sims.items()}
        self.status = (
            f"embedding score {value} ({len(missing)} sections embedded, {len(sections) - len(missing)} cached)"
        )
        return Data(data=data)

"""AJS Extract Contacts: regex pre-extract of emails, phones and the text around them.

The hints go into the job-brief prompt, where Gemma confirms the contact's name and role.
"""

import re

from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema.data import Data

EMAIL = re.compile(r"[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+(?:\.[\w-]+)+")
PHONE = re.compile(r"(?<![\w/])(?:\+|00)?\d{2}(?:[\s.-]?\d{2}){3,4}(?!\w)")
GENERIC = ("noreply", "no-reply", "donotreply", "privacy", "persondata", "gdpr")
WINDOW = 140
MAX_SNIPPETS = 4


def snippets(text: str, matches: list) -> list[str]:
    out: list[str] = []
    for m in matches:
        start, end = max(0, m.start() - WINDOW), min(len(text), m.end() + WINDOW)
        snippet = " ".join(text[start:end].split())
        if not any(snippet[:40] in s for s in out):
            out.append(snippet)
        if len(out) >= MAX_SNIPPETS:
            break
    return out


class AjsExtractContacts(Component):
    display_name = "AJS Extract Contacts"
    description = "Regex pre-extract of recruiter emails and phone numbers with surrounding text."
    name = "AjsExtractContacts"
    icon = "contact"

    inputs = [DataInput(name="posting", display_name="Posting", input_types=["Data"])]
    outputs = [Output(display_name="Posting", name="posting_out", method="extract")]

    def extract(self) -> Data:
        data = dict(self.posting.data)
        text = data["posting_text"]
        emails = [m for m in EMAIL.finditer(text) if not any(g in m.group().lower() for g in GENERIC)]
        phones = [m for m in PHONE.finditer(text) if 8 <= len(re.sub(r"\D", "", m.group())) <= 13]
        data["contact_hints"] = {
            "emails": sorted({m.group() for m in emails}),
            "phones": sorted({" ".join(m.group().split()) for m in phones})[:4],
            "snippets": snippets(text, sorted(emails + phones, key=lambda m: m.start())),
        }
        hints = data["contact_hints"]
        self.status = f"{len(hints['emails'])} email(s), {len(hints['phones'])} phone(s)"
        return Data(data=data)

code.name: code
code.value:
"""AJS Job Brief: Gemma extracts the job_brief JSON through Ollama structured outputs.

Plan 04 findings baked in: `format` is the JSON schema (never "json"), `think` is always sent
explicitly, temperature 0.2 with retries at 0.5 and 0.8 when the JSON is invalid (5 attempts), and no
`num_ctx` is sent (a different value would reload the model; ajs-gemma sets 32768 itself).
"""

import json
import re

import httpx
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import DataInput, MultilineInput, Output, StrInput
from lfx.schema.data import Data

# Gemma 4 on Ollama sometimes ends the JSON early (a dropped token inside an array string, or
# 'token repeat limit'); about 1 in 6 calls on some postings. Each failed attempt is cheap, so retry.
TEMPERATURES = (0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 0.5, 0.8)
MAX_TOKENS = 2048
MAX_POSTING_CHARS = 24000  # about 6-7k tokens; the posting is the only large input


JUNK = re.compile(r"[`{}\[\]]")


def semantic_problems(brief: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Structured output can still emit degenerate strings (seen: a must_have of "```json{ ")."""
    problems = []
    for key in ("must_have", "nice_to_have", "keywords", "company_values"):
        bad = [x for x in brief.get(key, []) if JUNK.search(x) or len(x.strip()) < 2]
        if bad:
            problems.append(f"{key} has junk items {bad[:2]}")
    if not brief.get("must_have"):
        problems.append("must_have is empty")
    return problems


def parse_json(text: str):
    text = text.strip()
    text = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*|\s*```$", "", text)
    return json.loads(text)


class AjsJobBrief(Component):
    display_name = "AJS Job Brief"
    description = "Extract the job_brief JSON (requirements, flags, contact) with Gemma via Ollama."
    name = "AjsJobBrief"
    icon = "brain"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(name="posting", display_name="Posting", input_types=["Data"]),
        MultilineInput(
            name="system_prompt",
            display_name="System prompt",
            info="Mirrored in langflow/prompts/analyst_job_brief.md.",
            value="",
        ),
        MultilineInput(
            name="schema_json",
            display_name="Output JSON schema",
            info="Mirrored in langflow/prompts/schemas/job_brief.schema.json.",
            value="{}",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="ollama_base_url",
            display_name="Ollama base URL",
            info="Global variable OLLAMA_BASE_URL.",
            value="OLLAMA_BASE_URL",
            load_from_db=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="model",
            display_name="Model",
            info="Global variable LLM_AGENT_MODEL (never hard-coded).",
            value="LLM_AGENT_MODEL",
            load_from_db=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="keep_alive",
            display_name="Keep alive",
            info="Global variable LLM_KEEP_ALIVE; the same value on every call.",
            value="LLM_KEEP_ALIVE",
            load_from_db=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [Output(display_name="Posting", name="posting_out", method="extract")]

    async def extract(self) -> Data:
        data = dict(self.posting.data)
        if data.get("already_analyzed") and data.get("job_brief"):
            self.status = "reused saved job_brief"
            return Data(data=data)

        schema = json.loads(self.schema_json)
        validator = Draft202012Validator(schema)
        hints = data.get("contact_hints") or {}
        user = f"POSTING\n{data['posting_text'][:MAX_POSTING_CHARS]}"
        if hints.get("emails") or hints.get("phones"):
            user += "\n\nCONTACT HINTS (regex): " + json.dumps(
                {k: hints.get(k) for k in ("emails", "phones", "snippets")}, ensure_ascii=False
            )
        messages = [
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": f"{self.system_prompt}\n\nJSON schema:\n{json.dumps(schema)}",
            },
            {"role": "user", "content": user},
        ]
        errors: list[str] = []
        brief = None
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=httpx.Timeout(300.0, connect=10.0)) as client:
            for temperature in TEMPERATURES:
                body = {
                    "model": self.model,
                    "messages": messages,
                    "stream": False,
                    "think": False,
                    "format": schema,
                    "keep_alive": self.keep_alive,
                    "options": {"temperature": temperature, "num_predict": MAX_TOKENS},
                }
                response = await client.post(f"{self.ollama_base_url.rstrip('/')}/api/chat", json=body)
                if response.status_code != 200:
                    errors.append(f"t={temperature}: HTTP {response.status_code} {response.text[:200]}")
                    continue
                try:
                    candidate = parse_json(response.json()["message"]["content"])
                except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
                    errors.append(f"t={temperature}: invalid JSON ({exc})")
                    continue
                problems = [e.message for e in validator.iter_errors(candidate)]
                if not problems:
                    problems = semantic_problems(candidate)
                if problems:
                    errors.append(f"t={temperature}: {problems[:3]}")
                    continue
                brief = candidate
                break
        if brief is None:
            msg = f"job_brief extraction failed at every temperature: {errors}"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        # The pre-check language is authoritative for the stored language.
        brief["language"] = data["language"]
        contact = brief.get("contact") or {}
        data["job_brief"] = brief
        data["recruiter_name"] = contact.get("name")
        data["recruiter_email"] = contact.get("email")
        data["recruiter_phone"] = contact.get("phone")
        self.status = f"must_have {len(brief['must_have'])}, nice_to_have {len(brief['nice_to_have'])}"
        return Data(data=data)

system_prompt.name: system_prompt
system_prompt.value:
Extract a job brief from the posting. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else, matching the JSON schema given below.
Rules:
- language is the posting language as an ISO 639-1 code (da or en).
- contact is the named recruiter or contact person with name, role, email and phone (null for unknown fields), or null if nobody is named. The user message may list CONTACT HINTS found by a regex pass: confirm or reject each one against the posting text, and take the name and role from the text next to it. Never invent a name, email or phone.
- must_have lists the required skills, experience and domain knowledge; nice_to_have lists the preferred ones. Do not put language requirements, location or work permit in must_have or nice_to_have; they belong in required_languages, danish_required, location and relocation_ok.
- seniority is the level as written (for example "senior", "lead", "junior") or null. remote describes remote or hybrid work as written, or null. deadline is the application deadline as written, or null.
- location is the work location as written (city or region), or null.
- relocation_ok is true if the posting offers relocation support or accepts candidates who still have to move, false if it requires living locally already, null if not stated.
- required_languages lists the ISO 639-1 codes of languages the posting requires (not "nice to have"). danish_required is true only if Danish is required.
- company_values lists values, principles or ways of working the posting itself states about the company (at most 3 short phrases of up to 4 words, in English); use [] if it states none. Never invent values.

"""AJS Load Posting: reads the flow input and decides whether this run has anything to do.

Input is the JSON string {"posting_id": 12, "posting_text": "..."} (posting_text is optional;
the backend copy is used when it is missing). The posting must be `new` or `analyzed` (a retry),
or `error` (reset to `new` first), so a run is idempotent and retryable (one run per job).
"""

import json

import httpx
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import MessageTextInput, Output, SecretStrInput, StrInput
from lfx.schema.data import Data
from lfx.schema.message import Message

RUNNABLE = {"new", "analyzed", "error"}


class AjsLoadPosting(Component):
    display_name = "AJS Load Posting"
    description = "Parse the flow input, fetch the posting from the backend and check its status."
    name = "AjsLoadPosting"
    icon = "download"

    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Input",
            info='JSON: {"posting_id": int, "posting_text": str (optional)}',
            input_types=["Message"],
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="backend_url",
            display_name="Backend URL",
            info="Global variable BACKEND_URL (FastAPI base including /api/v1).",
            value="http://backend:8000/api/v1",
        ),
        SecretStrInput(
            name="backend_api_key",
            display_name="Backend API key",
            info="Global variable BACKEND_API_KEY.",
            value="BACKEND_API_KEY",
            load_from_db=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Posting", name="posting", method="load_posting"),
        Output(display_name="Skipped", name="skipped", method="skipped"),
    ]

    async def _load(self) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None]:
        cached = getattr(self, "_ajs_result", None)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached
        raw = self.input_value
        raw = raw.text if hasattr(raw, "text") else str(raw or "")
        try:
            # The backend sends {"posting_id": 12}; a bare id such as "12" is accepted too.
            payload = {"posting_id": int(raw)} if raw.strip().isdigit() else json.loads(raw)
            posting_id = int(payload["posting_id"])
        except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
            msg = 'input must be JSON like {"posting_id": 12, "posting_text": "..."}'
            raise ValueError(msg) from exc
        headers = {"X-API-Key": self.backend_api_key}
        base = self.backend_url.rstrip("/")
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(headers=headers, timeout=30) as client:
            response = await client.get(f"{base}/postings/{posting_id}")
            response.raise_for_status()
            detail = response.json()
            status = detail["status"]
            if status not in RUNNABLE:
                result = (None, f"posting {posting_id} has status '{status}', nothing to analyze")
                self._ajs_result = result
                return result
            if status == "error":
                reset = await client.post(
                    f"{base}/tools/postings/{posting_id}/status",
                    json={"to": "new", "note": "retry analysis"},
                )
                reset.raise_for_status()
                status = "new"
        text = (payload.get("posting_text") or detail.get("posting_text") or "").strip()
        if not text:
            msg = f"posting {posting_id} has no text; set needs_manual_text in the caller"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        data = {
            "posting_id": posting_id,
            "posting_text": text,
            "company": detail["company"],
            "title": detail["title"],
            "status": status,
            "already_analyzed": status == "analyzed" and bool(detail.get("job_brief")),
        }
        if data["already_analyzed"]:
            data["job_brief"] = detail["job_brief"]
            data["language"] = detail.get("posting_language") or detail["job_brief"].get("language")
        self._ajs_result = (data, None)
        return self._ajs_result

    async def load_posting(self) -> Data:
        data, reason = await self._load()
        if data is None:
            self.stop("posting")
            return Data(data={"skipped": reason})
        self.stop("skipped")
        self.status = f"posting {data['posting_id']} ({data['status']})"
        return Data(data=data)

    async def skipped(self) -> Message:
        data, reason = await self._load()
        if data is not None:
            self.stop("skipped")
            return Message(text="")
        self.stop("posting")
        return Message(text=json.dumps({"skipped": True, "reason": reason}))

"""AJS Rubric Score: Gemma rates each requirement against the CV as met / partial / missing.

D10: only skills, experience and domain count. Language, location and work-permit items are
dropped before scoring (they are flags in job_brief). must_have counts twice as much as
nice_to_have. Plan 04 settings: thinking on at temperature 0.3, output capped at 3072 tokens,
one retry with thinking off when the cap is hit; `format` is a schema built for this call.
"""

import json
import re

import httpx
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import DataInput, MultilineInput, Output, SecretStrInput, StrInput
from lfx.schema.data import Data

THINK_TEMPERATURE = 0.3
THINK_MAX_TOKENS = 3072
PLAIN_MAX_TOKENS = 2048
WEIGHT = {"must_have": 2.0, "nice_to_have": 1.0}
CREDIT = {"met": 1.0, "partial": 0.5, "missing": 0.0}
# Requirements about spoken languages, location or permits are flags, never scored (D10).
NOT_SCORED = re.compile(
    r"\b(danish|dansk|english|engelsk|german|tysk|swedish|svensk|norwegian|norsk|fluent|"
    r"language skills|spoken|sprog|sprogkundskaber|work permit|arbejdstilladelse|located|based in|"
    r"relocat\w*|on-?site|commut\w*|bopæl)\b",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
MAX_RATIONALE_WORDS = 80


def clip_words(text: str, limit: int) -> str:
    words = text.split()
    return text.strip() if len(words) <= limit else " ".join(words[:limit]).rstrip(".,;") + "..."


class AjsRubricScore(Component):
    display_name = "AJS Rubric Score"
    description = "Rate must_have / nice_to_have against CV evidence with Gemma (weighted %, 0-100)."
    name = "AjsRubricScore"
    icon = "list-checks"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(name="posting", display_name="Posting", input_types=["Data"]),
        MultilineInput(
            name="system_prompt",
            display_name="System prompt",
            info="Mirrored in langflow/prompts/matcher_rubric.md.",
            value="",
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="ollama_base_url",
            display_name="Ollama base URL",
            info="Global variable OLLAMA_BASE_URL.",
            value="OLLAMA_BASE_URL",
            load_from_db=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="model",
            display_name="Model",
            info="Global variable LLM_AGENT_MODEL (never hard-coded).",
            value="LLM_AGENT_MODEL",
            load_from_db=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="keep_alive",
            display_name="Keep alive",
            info="Global variable LLM_KEEP_ALIVE.",
            value="LLM_KEEP_ALIVE",
            load_from_db=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="backend_url",
            display_name="Backend URL",
            info="Global variable BACKEND_URL (FastAPI base including /api/v1).",
            value="http://backend:8000/api/v1",
        ),
        SecretStrInput(
            name="backend_api_key",
            display_name="Backend API key",
            info="Global variable BACKEND_API_KEY.",
            value="BACKEND_API_KEY",
            load_from_db=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [Output(display_name="Posting", name="posting_out", method="score")]

    async def _ask(self, client, messages, schema, *, think: bool) -> dict | None:
        body = {
            "model": self.model,
            "messages": messages,
            "stream": False,
            "think": think,
            "format": schema,
            "keep_alive": self.keep_alive,
            "options": {
                "temperature": THINK_TEMPERATURE,
                "num_predict": THINK_MAX_TOKENS if think else PLAIN_MAX_TOKENS,
            },
        }
        response = await client.post(f"{self.ollama_base_url.rstrip('/')}/api/chat", json=body)
        response.raise_for_status()
        payload = response.json()
        if payload.get("done_reason") == "length":
            return None
        try:
            return json.loads(payload["message"]["content"])
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, TypeError):
            return None

    async def score(self) -> Data:
        data = dict(self.posting.data)
        brief = data["job_brief"]
        requirements: list[dict] = []
        dropped: list[str] = []
        for kind in ("must_have", "nice_to_have"):
            for index, text in enumerate(brief.get(kind) or [], start=1):
                if NOT_SCORED.search(text):
                    dropped.append(text)
                else:
                    requirements.append(
                        {"id": f"{'m' if kind == 'must_have' else 'n'}{index}", "kind": kind, "text": text}
                    )

        if not requirements:
            data.update(rubric_score=50.0, rationale="No scorable requirements were found in the posting.")
            data["rubric_detail"] = {"items": [], "dropped_flags": dropped, "note": "neutral 50, no requirements"}
            self.status = "no scorable requirements, neutral 50"
            return Data(data=data)

        async with httpx.AsyncClient(headers={"X-API-Key": self.backend_api_key}, timeout=30) as backend:
            response = await backend.get(f"{self.backend_url.rstrip('/')}/tools/profile/cv-sections")
            response.raise_for_status()
        sections = response.json()
        section_ids = {s["id"] for s in sections}

        ids = [r["id"] for r in requirements]
        schema = {
            "type": "object",
            "required": ["items", "rationale"],
            "properties": {
                "items": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "minItems": len(ids),
                    "maxItems": len(ids),
                    "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "required": ["id", "status", "evidence"],
                        "properties": {
                            "id": {"enum": ids},
                            "status": {"enum": ["met", "partial", "missing"]},
                            "evidence": {"type": "array", "items": {"enum": sorted(section_ids)}},
                        },
                    },
                },
                "rationale": {"type": "string"},
            },
        }
        cv_text = "\n\n".join(f"[{s['id']}]\n{s['markdown']}" for s in sections)
        req_text = "\n".join(f"{r['id']} ({r['kind']}): {r['text']}" for r in requirements)
        messages = [
            {"role": "system", "content": self.system_prompt},
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": f"JOB TITLE: {brief.get('title')}\n\nREQUIREMENTS\n{req_text}\n\nCV SECTIONS\n{cv_text}",
            },
        ]
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=httpx.Timeout(400.0, connect=10.0)) as client:
            result = await self._ask(client, messages, schema, think=True)
            used_think = True
            if result is None:  # capped, or unparseable: one retry with thinking off
                result = await self._ask(client, messages, schema, think=False)
                used_think = False
        if result is None:
            msg = "rubric scoring failed with thinking on and off"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        by_id = {i["id"]: i for i in result.get("items", []) if i.get("id") in ids}
        earned = total = 0.0
        detail = []
        for req in requirements:
            item = by_id.get(req["id"], {})
            status = item.get("status", "missing")
            evidence = [e for e in item.get("evidence", []) if e in section_ids]
            # Claims without a real CV citation do not get full credit.
            if status == "met" and not evidence:
                status = "partial"
            elif status == "partial" and not evidence:
                status = "missing"
            weight = WEIGHT[req["kind"]]
            earned += weight * CREDIT[status]
            total += weight
            detail.append({**req, "status": status, "evidence": evidence})
        rubric = round(100 * earned / total, 2)
        data["rubric_score"] = rubric
        data["rationale"] = clip_words(result.get("rationale", ""), MAX_RATIONALE_WORDS)
        data["rubric_detail"] = {"items": detail, "dropped_flags": dropped, "think": used_think}
        self.status = f"rubric {rubric} (think={used_think}, {len(dropped)} flag item(s) not scored)"
        return Data(data=data)

system_prompt.value:
You rate how well a candidate's CV covers each requirement of a job. For every requirement id in the REQUIREMENTS list give a status:
- met: the CV clearly shows this skill, experience or domain knowledge.
- partial: the CV shows something related or at a lower level.
- missing: the CV shows no evidence.
Cite the CV section ids (from the CV SECTIONS list) that support the status in evidence; use [] for missing. Cite only ids that exist, and only sections that really contain the evidence. Be strict: judge only what the CV states.
Only skills, experience and domain count. Never rate location, work permit or spoken languages; they are handled separately.
Reply with one JSON object and nothing else: {"items": [{"id": "<requirement id>", "status": "met|partial|missing", "evidence": ["<section id>"]}], "rationale": "<at most 60 words: the strongest matches and the biggest gaps, described in plain words, without requirement ids or section ids>"}. Give one item for every requirement id, in the same order.

from lfx.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from lfx.inputs.inputs import BoolInput

from lfx.services.deps import get_settings_service
from lfx.utils.constants import (
    MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
)
from lfx.utils.file_path_security import (
    component_file_access_scopes,
    enforce_local_file_access,
    is_local_file_access_restricted,
)


class ChatInput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "Chat Input"
    description = "Get chat inputs from the Playground."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/chat-input-and-output"
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Input Text",
            value="",
            info="Message to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
            info="Type of sender.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="context_id",
            display_name="Context ID",
            info="The context ID of the chat. Adds an extra layer to the local memory.",
            value="",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        FileInput(
            name="files",
            display_name="Files",
            file_types=TEXT_FILE_TYPES + IMG_FILE_TYPES,
            info="Files to be sent with the message.",
            advanced=True,
            is_list=True,
            temp_file=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Chat Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
    ]

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        # Ensure files is a list and filter out empty/None values
        files = self.files if self.files else []
        if files and not isinstance(files, list):
            files = [files]
        # Filter out None/empty values
        files = [f for f in files if f is not None and f != ""]

        # Build endpoints inject caller-controlled file references directly into
        # ChatInput. Resolve and validate local references before the Message can
        # later read them while constructing model attachment content.
        if files:
            settings_service = get_settings_service()
            storage_type = getattr(getattr(settings_service, "settings", None), "storage_type", "local")
            # The storage factory falls back to local storage for unsupported
            # values, so only the explicitly configured S3 backend may bypass
            # filesystem containment.
            if str(storage_type).lower() != "s3" and is_local_file_access_restricted():
                scope_ids = list(component_file_access_scopes(self))
                # Public executions replace graph.flow_id with a per-visitor
                # virtual ID. Only the server-populated source provenance may
                # restore the already-validated public attachment namespace.
                source_flow_id = getattr(self.graph, "source_flow_id", None)
                if source_flow_id:
                    scope_ids.append(source_flow_id)
                for file_path in get_file_paths(files):
                    enforce_local_file_access(file_path, scope_ids=scope_ids)

        session_id = self.session_id or self.graph.session_id or ""
        message = await Message.create(
            text=self.input_value,
            sender=self.sender,
            sender_name=self.sender_name,
            session_id=session_id,
            context_id=self.context_id,
            files=files,
        )
        if session_id and isinstance(message, Message) and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(
                message,
            )
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        self.status = message
        return message
